name: Clinic network refresh
result: Faster check-in, guest Wi-Fi kept separate
alt: Server rack with cabling to desks and a Wi-Fi access point
story: Old switches and patchy Wi-Fi were slowing down patient check-in. We replaced the core network, split guest and staff Wi-Fi, and documented every port.

challenge: A health clinic with two locations had check-in tablets that kept dropping off the Wi-Fi. Front-desk staff were re-entering patient details by hand.
The switches were nine years old. Patients and staff shared one Wi-Fi network, and nothing was documented.

steps.title: Survey both sites
steps.detail: We mapped coverage and found the dead spots behind the reception desks.

steps.title: Replace the core
steps.detail: New firewall, switches and access points at each location.

steps.title: Split the networks
steps.detail: Separate Wi-Fi for staff, patients and medical devices, kept apart from each other.

steps.title: Document everything
steps.detail: Every port labelled, and a network map handed to the clinic manager.

results: Check-in tablets have stayed connected since the refresh.
Patient check-in takes about half as long.
Guest Wi-Fi cannot reach anything that holds patient data.
